title: DCS — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for DCS.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Professional Outdoor." Premium tier. DCS (Dynamic Cooking Systems) is Fisher & Paykels professional outdoor cooking brand — built on commercial kitchen expertise. Features include ceramic radiant technology and a professional series of grills, carts, and components.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Premium outdoor kitchens paired with Fisher & Paykel indoor.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for DCS:

• Fisher & Paykel commercial heritage

• Ceramic radiant technology

• Professional-grade outdoor cooking

• Pairs with Fisher & Paykel indoor

• Strong build quality
